commentary.text: 90+6' Daniele Doveri is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter) produces a header from inside the penalty area, but he doesn't manage to hit the ball properly and it flies well wide of the left post.
90+4' The resulting corner, taken by Federico Dimarco (Inter), comes to nothing.
90+3' The corner from Federico Dimarco (Inter) is intercepted by Mike Maignan.
90+3' Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. Inter have been awarded a corner kick.
90+2' Federico Dimarco (Inter) launches a cross from the corner, but Mike Maignan is alert to thwart the effort.
90+2' Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Luka Modric (AC Milan) is booked.

84' Massimiliano Allegri has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan) replacing Christian Pulisic.
80' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Daniele Doveri didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
80' We are about to witness a subsitution. Andy Diouf (Inter) for Yann Bisseck.
78' Mike Maignan steps in and intercepts a long pass from Yann Bisseck (Inter).

69' Daniele Doveri shows the yellow card to Denzel Dumfries (Inter) for a heavy challenge.
69' Here is a change. Nicolo Barella is going off and Cristian Chivu gives the last tactical orders to Davide Frattesi (Inter).
68' Problems for Cristian Chivu as Alessandro Bastoni is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Carlos Augusto (Inter) replaces him.
68' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) is able to continue to play.

66' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
65' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) was quite harsh and Daniele Doveri didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
63' A cross is whipped into the centre of the box towards Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter). He gets a good contact on the ball but heads it high over the bar.

60' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) bursts inside the box, beats two defenders and produces a strike from the penalty spot. The shot has power, but lacks precision and the goalkeeper stops it easily. The scoreline remains the same.
60' Cristian Chivu prepares a substitution. Luis Henrique is replaced by Denzel Dumfries (Inter).

54' Federico Dimarco (Inter) sends in a shot from a promising distance after a precise pass. His effort goes inches over the crossbar.

51' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range low towards the middle of the target, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
50' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) goes for goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies yards wide of the right post.
49' The resulting corner from Federico Dimarco (Inter) is cleared.

48' A loose ball is pounced on by Piotr Zielinski (Inter) inside the box. He immediately fires in a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Mike Maignan is alert and makes a comfortable save. The ball goes out of play and Inter have been awarded a corner kick.
47' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) plays a through ball but overhits it.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.

45+3' Federico Dimarco (Inter) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
45+3' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
45+1' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar.
45+1' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
44' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header directed towards the goal is brilliantly saved by the goalkeeper.
43' Corner kick. Luka Modric (AC Milan) is ready to send the ball into the box.
43' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan). The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for AC Milan.
42' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
41' Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) unleashes a strike towards goal from long-range, but the ball is blocked by one of his teammates.
40' Luis Henrique (Inter) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
39' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles over the bar.
38' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
35' 1 - 0 Youssouf Fofana feeds the ball through to Pervis Estupinan (AC Milan), who picks up the pass inside the box and quickly sends it into the top left corner! The goalkeeper was helpless. 1:0!

34' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) weaves through the defence with ease and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score with his strike towards the middle of the target as Mike Maignan produces a good save.
33' Luka Modric (AC Milan) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
32' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Daniele Doveri blows for a foul.

28' Federico Dimarco (Inter) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
24' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
21' Federico Dimarco (Inter) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires high and wide.
20' Pervis Estupinan (AC Milan) brings his opponent down. Daniele Doveri has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
18' Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
16' Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
16' Federico Dimarco (Inter) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
14' Federico Dimarco (Inter) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
